plugin.name: Hyper3D
plugin.description: Generate and texture 3D models with Hyper3D Rodin.
plugin.longDescription: Optional Beta for your Hyper3D API account. Includes text and image generation, multiview references, texturing, balance and editable model versions. Requires OhMyGame API 2.16.
config.key.title: Hyper3D API key
config.key.description: Create a key in your Hyper3D API dashboard. Generation and texturing use your Hyper3D credits.
